title: Migrations 000020-000022 (historic — already merged)
dod: Schema for all 5 aggregates live in DB (commit 931deca). No new work — placeholder for traceability.

title: OrgMemberChecker.IsMethodist + IsAdmin Go funcs
dod: IsMethodist(ctx, orgID, userID) and IsAdmin(ctx, orgID, userID) implemented, unit-tested (>=90% coverage), wired into DI.

title: Outbox infrastructure (migration 000023 + Go pkg)
dod: outbox_events table created via migration 000023; Go package for insert-in-tx and poller stub; integration test validates idempotent dispatch.

title: Redis token-bucket rate-limit helper
dod: RateLimiter interface with Redis token-bucket implementation; unit-tested with mock Redis; reusable across POST /courses and POST /comments.

title: Redis Idempotency-Key dedup helper
dod: IdempotencyStore interface with Redis SET NX / 24h TTL; unit-tested; used by publish endpoints.

title: Course domain entity + factory
dod: Course struct with sentinel errors (course.not_found, course.no_published_lessons, course.not_methodist, course.already_published); factory func; unit tests.

title: PostgresCourseRepository (5 methods) + integration tests
dod: Create, FindByID, FindAllByOrg, UpdateStatus, CountPublishedLessons implemented; org_id filter invariant; integration tests cover cross-org draft-leak scenario.

title: Lesson + LessonBlock domain + factory
dod: Lesson and LessonBlock structs with sentinel errors (lesson.not_found, lesson.sequence_conflict, block.invalid_type, block.sequence_conflict); factories; unit tests.

title: PostgresLessonRepository (7 methods) + UNIQUE translation
dod: Create, FindByID, FindAllByCourse, AddBlock, UpdateSequence, Publish, CountForCourse; pq.unique_violation translated to domain error; integration tests.

title: POST /courses (createCourse + rate-limit)
dod: Handler: validate description length, IsMethodist gate, rate-limit 30 req/min, INSERT course, 201/400/403/429 responses; handler unit tests.

title: GET /courses + GET /courses/{id} (existence-hiding)
dod: List returns published + owner-draft; GetByID applies cross-org 404 (AC-07) and draft-leak 404 (AC-08); handler unit tests.

title: POST /courses/{id}/publish (outbox + idempotency)
dod: Handler: CountPublishedLessons gate, UPDATE+outbox in single tx, Idempotency-Key dedup, idempotent re-publish returns 200; handler unit tests.

title: PATCH /courses/{id}/lessons/reorder
dod: Handler: len<=50 check, draft-only gate, batch UPDATE in tx, UNIQUE violation rolled back; handler unit tests.

title: POST /courses/{id}/lessons (createCourseLesson)
dod: Handler: parent course org-filter (AC-10), sequence auto-assign, INSERT+outbox in tx, 201/404/409 responses; handler unit tests.

title: GET /lessons + GET /lessons/{id} (no peer-signal yet)
dod: List with course_id filter + cursor; GetByID with existence-hiding for draft/cross-org; blocks in response; handler unit tests.

title: POST /lessons/{id}/blocks (polymorphic payload)
dod: Handler validates block_type enum (4 types per ADR-0001), inserts block row, 201/400/404/409 responses; handler unit tests.

title: POST /lessons/{id}/publish (outbox + idempotency)
dod: Handler: course-owner check, UPDATE+outbox in single tx, Idempotency-Key dedup, idempotent re-publish returns 200; handler unit tests.

title: LessonCompletion domain + repo + tests
dod: LessonCompletion struct; PostgresCompletionRepository with Create (UNIQUE idempotent), FindByUserLesson; org_id filter invariant; integration tests.

title: POST /lessons/{id}/completion (idempotent via UNIQUE)
dod: Handler: published-lesson gate (AC-12), INSERT with UNIQUE idempotent path (201 first / 200 repeat); handler unit tests.

title: Peer-blob aggregation + Redis cache (60s TTL)
dod: PeerBlobService: aggregate COUNT + recent 5 public completers, write-through Redis cache 60s TTL; anti-fingerprinting threshold count<3 returns null; cache-miss fallback to DB; unit tests.

title: Extend GET /lessons/{id} with peer_completion field
dod: Lesson GET handler enriched with PeerBlobService result; peer_completion embedded in response; my_completed flag correct; handler unit tests.

title: UserPreference + audit domain + repo
dod: UserPreference struct; PostgresPreferenceRepository with UPSERT + audit INSERT in tx; default private on no-row; integration tests.

title: GET /me/preferences + PATCH /me/preferences handlers
dod: GET returns default private on no-row (lazy default); PATCH upserts + audit in tx; 400 on invalid enum; handler unit tests.

title: Comment + CommentAudit domain + repo
dod: Comment struct with sentinel errors (comment.not_found, comment.not_moderator); PostgresCommentRepository Create, FindByID, ListByLesson, Hide+audit in tx; integration tests.

title: POST /lessons/{id}/comments (rate-limit + HTML escape)
dod: Handler: length check (2000 chars), rate-limit 10/h/user, published-lesson gate, server-side HTML-escape before INSERT, 201/400/404/429 responses; handler unit tests.

title: GET /lessons/{id}/comments (cursor pagination + placeholder)
dod: List with keyset cursor on (created_at DESC, id), default page_size=20, hidden comments show placeholder; handler unit tests.

title: POST /comments/{id}/hide (admin + audit trail)
dod: Handler: IsAdmin gate, UPDATE+audit INSERT in tx (original content preserved), 200/403/404 responses; handler unit tests.

title: E2E: course-lesson lifecycle + cross-org 404
dod: HTTP E2E: create course, add block-based lesson, publish lesson, publish course, verify visibility matrix (same-org member sees 200, cross-org 404, draft non-owner 404).

title: E2E: peer-signal + preferences + anti-fingerprinting
dod: HTTP E2E: mark completion (idempotent 201/200), set peer_visibility=public, GET lesson verifies peer_completion field, verifies count<3 threshold returns null.

title: E2E: comments + moderation + audit preservation
dod: HTTP E2E: post comment, list comments, admin hides comment (original preserved in audit), non-admin hide returns 403.
